joi_block.name: Scenario
joi_block.script:
triggered := false
if (triggered == true) {
wait until(not (all(#LightSensor).lightSensor_brightness <| 100))
    triggered = false
}
wait until(all(#LightSensor).lightSensor_brightness <| 100)
all(#Light).light_moveToBrightness(100.0, 0.0)
triggered = true

precision_reasoning: confirmed ir_gt + binding_gt; no NL mapping
command_kor: 조도가 100룩스 미만이 될 때마다 조명을 켜줘.
command_eng: Each time the brightness level falls below 100 lux, turn on the light.
